start: Owner on the Challenges page of an online gym; no challenge is running

user_sees: Title "Challenges", line "A challenge for your members. Everyone who reaches the goal wins." (a gym with branches: "A challenge for <branch>’s members. Each branch has its own.")
Ready-made challenges with "Turn on"
Button "New challenge"
"No challenge is running"
must_not: Another branch's challenge shown as this one
An endless "Loading…"

user_sees: Sheet "New challenge"
Name box (example "November challenge", hint "Members see this name. At most 60 letters.")
"What counts": "Workouts", "Kg lifted" (and "Visits" where check-ins can count)
"First day" ("Today or a later day, up to 60 days from today.")
"How many days" ("From 7 to 31 days.")
"Free days for everyone who reaches the goal" ("From 0 to 60. You check each winner before the days are added.")
"Fill in the boxes above to see what members will read."
must_not: The sheet opening with another challenge's values

steps.action: Fill the name, the goal, first day today, 30 days, 7 free days
user_sees: A preview of what members will read
must_not: A preview that differs from what is saved

user_sees: "Saving…"
A toast "Challenge saved. Members see it in the MettleUp app within 10 minutes."
The challenge card with "Running now", "Change" and "Cancel challenge"
must_not: Two challenges from one tap
A second challenge running at the same time
Free days given to anyone at this moment

start: Owner on the Challenges page; ready-made challenges are listed

steps.action: Tap "Turn on" on a ready-made challenge (reads "Turn on from <day>" when another challenge is in its way)
user_sees: A toast saying it is on and from which day (exact words: unknown)
The card now offers "Change" and the turn-off button
must_not: It starts today while another challenge is still running
A second tap makes a second challenge

steps.action: Tap "Change" on that card, change the free days and tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The sheet titled with the challenge name; after saving, the card shows the new numbers
must_not: A new challenge made instead of changing this one

start: Owner on the Challenges page; a challenge with 7 free days is running or just finished and three members reached the goal

user_sees: A list "Members who reached the goal of <title>" with each name
For each winner waiting: a button to give the free days and "Skip"
A button to give all waiting winners at once
"Copy this list"
"Open Members"
must_not: A member who did not reach the goal on the list
Free days already added before the owner tapped

steps.action: Tap the give button on one winner
user_sees: "Saving…" on that button, then a toast saying what happened for that member
The winner no longer asks for a confirm
must_not: The days added twice
The days added to another member
A plan that had ended pushed forward without saying so

steps.action: Tap the give-all button for the rest
user_sees: "Saving…", then "Done for {n} winners. Each line says what happened."
must_not: Some winners given and some not, with a success toast
A winner given the days twice

user_sees: A toast saying what happened; no days added for that member
must_not: Days added after a skip

user_sees: "List copied. You can paste it into WhatsApp." (or "Could not copy. Select the names and copy them by hand.")
must_not: Mobile numbers in the copied list

start: Owner on the Challenges page, sheet "New challenge"

steps.action: Tap "Start challenge" with the name empty
user_sees: "Give the challenge a name, like “November challenge”."
must_not: A challenge saved with no name

steps.action: Type a goal of 0; then a first day of yesterday; then 5 days; then 61 free days
user_sees: "Type the goal as a number above 0."
"It can start today or later, not on a day that has passed."
"It must run from 7 to 31 days."
"Free days must be a whole number from 0 to 60."
must_not: Any of these saved
The sheet closing with the error unread

steps.action: Pick "Visits", type a goal larger than the number of days
user_sees: "The visits goal cannot be more than the number of days the challenge runs."
must_not: A goal nobody can reach saved

steps.action: Close the sheet; open the page on a gym that is not online, and on a gym whose server lacks challenges
user_sees: "Challenges need your gym online" / "Members’ phones read the challenge from your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)."
"Challenges are not switched on for your gym yet" / "They will appear here once your gym’s server has them."
must_not: A "New challenge" button that can never save

start: Owner on the Challenges page; a challenge is running

user_sees: Sheet "Cancel this challenge?" with "Keep it" and "Cancel challenge"
must_not: The challenge cancelled on the first tap

user_sees: The sheet closes; the challenge still reads "Running now"
must_not: The challenge cancelled

user_sees: A toast "Challenge cancelled. Members no longer see it."
"No challenge is running"
The challenge under "Past challenges" marked "Cancelled", with no winners list
must_not: Members still see it in the app after 10 minutes
Free days given for a cancelled challenge

user_sees: It can start today
must_not: The cancelled challenge still blocking the day

start: Owner on the Challenges page with winners waiting

steps.action: Read the winners list and the note under it
user_sees: Winners by name; free days are added only when the owner confirms each one
must_not: Winners of another branch or gym
A member who hid their name still listed to other members by this page's action
A workout counted on a day the register shows no check-in for that member

start: Front-desk staff on the Challenges page; the owner has a challenge running

user_sees: Title "Challenges"
"Only the owner can start, change or cancel a challenge. You can see who has reached the goal."
The running challenge with "Running now"
Under the ready-made list: "Only the owner can turn these challenges on or off."
must_not: A "New challenge", "Change", "Cancel challenge" or "Turn on" button

user_sees: The winners by name and a note that the owner gives the free days
must_not: A button that gives or skips free days

start: Front-desk staff on the Challenges page; members reached the goal

steps.action: Tap "Copy this list" under the winners
user_sees: "List copied. You can paste it into WhatsApp."
must_not: Mobile numbers in the copied text

user_sees: The Members page
must_not: Free days added by opening it

start: Front-desk staff on the Challenges page; nothing is running

user_sees: "No challenge is running" / "The owner has not started one."
must_not: A way to start one
A blank page

steps.action: Open the page on a gym that is not online
user_sees: "Challenges need your gym online"
must_not: An endless "Loading…"

start: Front-desk staff on the Challenges page; the owner cancels the running challenge on another device

user_sees: "No challenge is running"; the old one under "Past challenges" marked "Cancelled"
must_not: The cancelled challenge still shown as "Running now" after a reload

steps.action: Look at a finished challenge under "Past challenges"
user_sees: Its summary and the winners; where the owner has confirmed, the line says what happened
must_not: Give or skip buttons for staff

start: Front-desk staff on the Challenges page with winners listed

user_sees: Names of members of this gym who reached the goal; no way to add days
must_not: A staff login adding free days (money's worth) to a member
Winners of another branch
